name: Body Image
overview: Scripture reveals that human beings are uniquely created in the image and likeness of God, affirming the inherent worth and dignity of every person (Genesis 1:26-27). Our bodies are fearfully and wonderfully made by God, deserving of praise and respect (Psalms 139:14). True beauty is not found in outward appearance but in a reverent fear of the Lord, which brings lasting honor (Proverbs 31:30). Believers are called to offer their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, focusing on spiritual transformation rather than conforming to worldly standards (Romans 12:1-2).
